title: Task
description: A protocol v1 task record. Owner is a participant ID; the participants live right here.

schemaVersion.description: The record's schema version. A newer one blocks the record without changing the store.

owner.description: The owning participant's ID. There is always exactly one; changing it takes an explicit claim.

adapter.description: The adapter's metadata as an opaque object: the core never looks inside it.

timestamp.description: Exactly what Date#toISOString prints: the date-time format alone is not enough — it allows offsets.
